views.purpose: The Component-and-Connector Runtime View uses runtime components, connectors, and communication channels to answer the architectural questions regarding high-level architecture, component responsibilities, interactions, and control flow during the registration process.
required_evidence: connectors and communication pathways for validation and persistence
execution flow during valid, invalid, or duplicate data handling
modules or classes owning persistence and role-specific data management logic
views.diagram_language_rule: viewpoint agent chose plantuml: PlantUML can effectively depict runtime components, connectors, and communication flows required to answer connectivity and control-flow questions for the user registration functionality.

notes: Eligible because they frame the chosen concerns: module-decomposition, context, cnc-runtime, code-mapping

Module decomposition was rejected because it focuses primarily on static module structures rather than runtime execution flow and connectivity; system context is too high-level and lacks internal component collaboration details; code-mapping focuses on implementation types rather than architectural runtime interactions needed by an integrator.

diagram language plantuml: viewpoint agent chose plantuml: PlantUML can effectively depict runtime components, connectors, and communication flows required to answer connectivity and control-flow questions for the user registration functionality.
